jobs.title: Manufacturing Operator
jobs.education: High school diploma or equivalent; technical certificate preferred
jobs.summary: Execute batch manufacturing for topical and oral non-sterile products while following SOPs and safety standards.
jobs.responsibilities:
Operate compounding and packaging equipment per approved procedures
Complete batch documentation accurately and in real time
Perform line clearance and equipment cleaning
Escalate deviations and safety concerns promptly
Maintain a clean and organized production area
jobs.requirements:
1+ year experience in pharmaceutical or regulated manufacturing preferred
Ability to follow written SOPs and work instructions
Willingness to work in a cleanroom/production environment
Basic computer skills and strong teamwork
jobs.preferredQualifications:
Experience with creams, gels, ointments, or solutions
Prior cGMP training
jobs.benefits:
Competitive hourly pay
Shift differential where applicable
Health benefits and paid leave

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
jobs.education: Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Pharmacy, or related field
jobs.summary: Support QA systems for semi-solid and liquid pharmaceutical manufacturing, ensuring cGMP compliance and continuous improvement.
jobs.responsibilities:
Review batch records and release documentation
Support CAPA, deviations, and change control
Partner with manufacturing and QC on quality investigations
Maintain SOPs and training records
Support internal and regulatory audits
jobs.requirements:
3+ years QA experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing
Strong knowledge of cGMP and FDA regulations
Excellent documentation and attention to detail
Ability to work cross-functionally in a regulated environment
jobs.preferredQualifications:
Experience with semi-solid or liquid dosage forms
Prior audit support experience
Familiarity with TrackWise or similar QMS tools
jobs.benefits:
Competitive compensation
Health, dental, and vision coverage
Paid time off and holidays
Professional development opportunities
